@Andrew Crago @Victoria Wang @Brent Trotter @Meridel Walkington - As we are working on the settings for AI Window concurrently (so, the additional settings users will need for AI Window BEYOND being able to turn it on / off), @Yulia Popova has explored some more options here that I wanted to give you visibility to as well.

Pasting her rationale from Slack:

"At the same time, the AI Window feature is big enough to deserve its own card. Maybe even its own toggle? It felt odd to see a small toggle for the smart window inside the “AI features available in Firefox” card alongside smaller features.

Since AI Window already has its own switch - you can switch between Classic and AI Window - I’m wondering whether a user could turn off all AI features in Classic and keep AI Window on, so they’d only use AI features when they’re in the AI Window.

Based on that thinking, I put together another option: one page for all AI features, a separate card (or could be a section) for AI Window, and separate toggles/buttons to turn all AI features and the AI Window on or off independently. Just an idea.

@Brent Trotter - Wanted to get your take on this approach, which has "AI Window" as it's own page. While we don't have a volume of settings for AI Window right now, this is moreso a hedge against needing to add more settings in the future. And, there's some feedback from Emanuela (see Notes) that this might be a cleaner mental model. Curious your thoughts / take on this. If we proceed with our own page, any words of wisdom / caution?
